howItWorksCapture.message: When you visit a page whose URL contains an affiliate key, the extension identifies and stores that URL in an internal list. This lets you access it quickly without searching for it again.

howItWorksExpiry.message: The extension also tracks the 24-hour window associated with the key to indicate when that period may have ended. This indicator cannot confirm that your Amazon session has expired, but it may mean that the session associated with the affiliate key needs to be renewed.

howItWorksOpen.message: The affiliate tag does not need to remain visible in the address bar while browsing: Amazon may store it in a cookie that tracks purchases for the next 24 hours, even if the parameter disappears from the URL.

howItWorksPrivacy.message: The extension does not collect or send data. Keys and URLs are managed locally in your browser without connecting to external services; opening a saved URL requires a connection to that website. You can view the source code through the link on the author's name in the extension footer.

howItWorksDisclaimer.message: Amazon manages the session. Therefore, the extension cannot guarantee that a change will take effect immediately or confirm the session status.
